name: Boulder
blurb: Drag hands and feet up the wall, mind your grip and top out!

background.css: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(20,16,13,.95) 0%, rgba(20,16,13,.72) 45%, rgba(20,16,13,0) 80%), radial-gradient(ellipse 22px 14px at 74% 30%, #5FCF7A 0 98%, transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 16px 11px at 58% 18%, #F2D23C 0 98%, transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 26px 17px at 82% 12%, #FFD32A 0 98%, transparent), radial-gradient(circle, rgba(20,16,13,.35) 1.4px, transparent 2px) 0 0/14px 14px, linear-gradient(160deg, #d8ab72 0%, #C9995F 55%, #a77a46 100%)

source.notes: From the Claude Design card (Boulder Card.dc.html): BOULDER in Lilita One on chalk #F5F1E8 with the design's dark-to-clear ink overlay. Blurb reworded by Dan's request (was the design's "Reach the top."). The design used a screenshot of the wall; url() isn't allowed on cards, so the plywood pegboard and a few route holds (green, yellow, gold TOP) are drawn in CSS instead.
